scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const cp=(s,d)=>{fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(d),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(s,d)};const dist='frontend/dist';const assets=fs.readdirSync(path.join(dist,'assets'));['ui','backend/public'].forEach(root=>{fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root,'assets'),{recursive:true});cp(path.join(dist,'index.html'),path.join(root,'index.html'));assets.forEach(f=>cp(path.join(dist,'assets',f),path.join(root,'assets',f)));});console.log('UI published to ui/ and backend/public');"
